# Pinned native entity editor references

Source: WorkAdventure commit96d43a841766b22418c061744e7ed2aafd9870d3. Exact upstream paths, URLs and SHA256s are in provenance.json. LICENSE.txt is the exact upstream play license, AGPLv3 with Commons Clause; preserve the full notice. No upstream implementation behavior was modified in these .txt fixtures.

The test harness transpiles actual original Zod declarations through WAMEntityData and the exact collection migration. No PNG is vendored; existing deployed frontend already serves all110 original images.

http-closure.json records public2026-10-17 catalog/PNG results and pinned hashes, not a fresh availability test. Normal CI uses these receipts offline. Frontend upgrades must revalidate the exact same-origin catalog/image closure separately. builder-before.json freezes all33 original builder native and noncatalog-WAM semantic hashes at8dc37e1 before the catalog-only implementation. Source WAM/live organizer preservation has separate root-owned tests and migration; no generated WAM can replace live user edits.
